result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: an unexpected dark horizontal overlay appears across the bottom navigation area, obscuring navigation icons.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal line is drawn across the bottom tab bar, overlapping the search and saved/bookmark icons. It looks like a misplaced system/home indicator or rendering artifact and makes the navigation look broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the overlay so it sits below the tab bar/safe area, and ensure bottom navigation icons are not covered by any system indicator or custom view.
